status: written after frozen Draft 2 audit and before v3 replay timings; same-data repair, not a new held-out study
cases: same 38 cases and exact original seeded 128-query batches
selection: minimum actual SC binary bytes among at most 16 candidate partitions plus XOR and flat fallback
sequence: build/discover, verify if representation changes, serialize, discard original object, construct fresh object from serialization, reverify against external source, execute the 128 queries on loaded instance
timing: record separate phases and one actual complete elapsed interval; no untimed warm batch before queries
boundary: common truth extraction and query generation excluded; in-memory logical persistence, not cold disk/new OS process; the reference packed serialized form regenerates its masks on load
comparability: representation schemas deliberately differ; this is end-to-end reference sensitivity, not optimized compressor or CUDD contest
continuation: record each completed case and preserve it; explicit start/end chunks are fixed by runtime limits, never by outcomes
statistics: per-case medians of five complete elapsed intervals; Q=128 directly executed, no Q=1000 claim from this arm
